title: Amputation due to any cause
summary: Amputation that meets one of four scenarios: both upper extremities, hemipelvectomy/hip disarticulation, lower extremity at/above ankle precluding effective ambulation, or one hand and one lower extremity precluding effective ambulation.

children.criterion: Amputation of both upper extremities at or above the wrist
Amputation of one or both lower extremities at or above the ankle, with stump complications precluding effective prosthetic use, lasting ≥12 months
Amputation of one or both lower extremities at or above the ankle
Stump complications (non-healing wounds, ulceration, instability) preventing or precluding effective prosthetic use
Documented medical need for walker, bilateral canes, bilateral crutches, or two-handed wheeled mobility device
Amputation of one hand AND one lower extremity at or above the ankle, with two-handed assistive device need lasting ≥12 months
Amputation of one upper extremity at or above the wrist AND one lower extremity at or above the ankle
Documented medical need for walker, bilateral canes, bilateral crutches, or two-handed wheeled mobility device, lasting ≥12 months
